name: A Chinese painting on silk (ink and light mineral colour on plain-woven silk, paper-backed in its mount): the image in the silk

diffuseAlbedo.note: The reflectance a photograph of the silk's white stands for: a first value, until an old painting silk is measured. The silk's tone, darkened with age, is in the photograph itself.

refractiveIndex.source: Substances/silk.json: optics.refractiveIndex (fibroin 1.5307 at 632.8 nm, 1.5511 at 473 nm)
refractiveIndex.derivation: the index near 550 nm between the two, as silk.warm-grey's

porosity.source: Shading/Substances/silk.warm-grey.json (a closely woven silk's void share)

wettingDepth.source: the silk and its paper backing
wettingDepth.note: A mounted painting is the silk on two or three layers of paper: water reaches all of it.
